notes.title: Phone bar holds five menus
added: Press and hold the bottom bar to choose which menus sit there.
changed: The phone bar shows five menus: Calculator, Inventory, CRM, Dealer, and Chat.
notes.how: Press and hold any icon on the bottom bar until they wiggle. Drag to change the order. Tap the red minus to take one off. Tap a name in the row above to add it. You can keep five. Tap Done when it looks right, or Reset to put the original five back. The side menu still has every page.

notes.title: What’s new, and a guide you can reopen
added: A What’s new log of screen changes, in plain language.
A guide that lists what each Company and Dealer Portal menu is for.
A refresh bar if you left a tab open while we updated.
notes.how: After you sign in, a card appears if there is a note you have not seen. Click Got it to dismiss it, or See all updates to open the full log. You can reopen it any time: Settings → What’s new. Settings → Company guide (or Dealer guide) explains every menu. If you keep this tab open and we ship a change, a bar at the top asks you to refresh when you are ready. It does not refresh by itself, so a quote you are still typing is not wiped.

company.title: Dashboard
company.text: Your start page. See a count for each area, then open the one you need.

company.title: Calculator
company.text: Size an LED wall for a job. Enter the screen size, pick a panel, and save the layout when you are ready to quote it.

company.title: Website → Products
company.text: The panel series on the public product pages. Change photos, specs, and which series are live.

company.title: Website → Store
company.text: What shoppers can buy on the US Store. Set the street price and the qty that can sell, then sync those items so checkout works.

company.title: Website → Accounts
company.text: People who created a website login. Look someone up when they cannot sign in or you need to see their account.

company.title: Website → Traffic
company.text: Who visited the site and which pages they opened. Use it to see what is getting attention.

company.title: Inventory
company.text: What is in the warehouse. Look up an item and see how many you have, then open it to change the qty or the details.

company.title: Inventory → Location
company.text: Your warehouses and bins. Use this when the same item sits in more than one place.

company.title: Inventory → Receipt Shipment
company.text: A shipment that arrived. Match it to the purchase order so the on-hand qty goes up.

company.title: Vendor
company.text: Companies you buy from. Open a supplier to see their contact, terms, and the products you buy from them.

company.title: Vendor → Purchase Order
company.text: An order you send to a vendor. Write it, email it, and keep it here until the goods arrive.

company.title: CRM → Lead
company.text: A new inquiry. Open it, assign it, and turn it into a customer when they are ready to buy.

company.title: CRM → Pipeline
company.text: Deals in progress, stage by stage. Move a deal forward when the next step happens.

company.title: CRM → Activity
company.text: Calls, emails, and tasks that are due. Use this so a follow-up does not sit.

company.title: Customer
company.text: Companies you already sell to. Open an account for contacts, addresses, and what you have sold them.

company.title: Customer → Sales Quote
company.text: A price you send before they buy. Build it, email it, and turn it into an order when they say yes.

company.title: Customer → Sales Order
company.text: A confirmed sale. What they are buying, where it ships, and where the order stands.

company.title: Customer → Invoice
company.text: What they owe. Send it, then mark it paid when the money comes in.

company.title: Installed walls
company.text: A wall that has shipped. Open one for the site, serials, spare kit, and warranty dates.

company.title: Dealer
company.text: Dealers you already work with. Open one for contacts, a portal login, and what you have sold them.

company.title: Dealer → Applications
company.text: Dealer applications that came in from the site. Open one, then approve or decline it.

company.title: Dealer → Deal registration
company.text: Jobs a dealer registered so you can protect the opportunity. Open one to review it.

company.title: Dealer → RMA
company.text: Return requests from dealers. Open one to see what they sent back and where it stands.

company.title: Chat
company.text: A message to other staff. Use it while you are still on the quote, order, or customer you are talking about.

company.title: Settings → Company
company.text: Your company name, address, and logo. This is what prints on quotes, orders, and invoices.

company.title: Settings → Forms
company.text: The layout of quotes, orders, and invoices. Change it here when a document should look different.

company.title: Settings → Manage users
company.text: Staff logins. Add a person, choose what they can open, and turn off someone who left.

company.title: Settings → What’s new
company.text: The log of screen changes. Added, changed, or removed, in plain language. New functions also say where to click.

company.title: Settings → Company guide
company.text: This list. What each menu is for, so someone new can find their way.

portal.title: Dashboard
portal.text: Your start page. See counts for the price book, quote requests, orders, and saved projects, then open one.

portal.title: Dealer book
portal.text: Your price list. Search a SKU to see your price and what is on hand. Factory cost is not on this page.

portal.title: Request Quote
portal.text: Ask Spectrum to price a job. Send the request here, then come back to read the quote they return.

portal.title: Purchase Order
portal.text: Orders you have placed with Spectrum. Open one to see what you ordered and where it stands.

portal.title: Installed walls
portal.text: Walls you installed. Open one for the site, serials, spare kit, and warranty dates.

portal.title: Deal registration
portal.text: Register a named job so Spectrum can protect the opportunity. Open one to see if it was accepted.

portal.title: RMA
portal.text: Ask to return goods. Open a request to see what you sent and where it stands.

portal.title: Calculator
portal.text: Size a wall for your customer. Pick a panel and see the cabinet count at your price.

portal.title: Projects
portal.text: Wall layouts you saved. Open one to keep working, or send it as a quote request.

portal.title: Saved Panel
portal.text: Panels you use often. Pick one so the calculator starts on that series.

portal.title: Settings → Company
portal.text: Your dealer company on the portal. Name, address, and the people who can sign in on this account.

portal.title: Settings → What’s new
portal.text: The log of portal screen changes, in plain language.

portal.title: Settings → Dealer guide
portal.text: This list. What each menu is for.
